pageCache.text:
Visions and Values
‘Realising Potential through Faith, Hope and Love’
‘And now these three remain: FAITH, HOPE and LOVE, But the greatest of these is LOVE.’
Our Vision At St. Andrew’s (Barnsbury), we believe that every member of our community is unique, cherished and valued as a child of God. Inspired by the letters of St Paul to the Corinthians and rooted in the principle of Christian hope, we aim to realise potential by giving our children the opportunities, aspirations and skills to flourish and thrive in an ever changing and challenging world. Grounded in Christian faith, our school is a nurturing and inclusive environment where children learn how to live well together, celebrate and embrace differences and learn to love one another as Christ loves us.

pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome | St Andrew's Church of England Primary School
pageCache.text:
Welcome
Welcome to St. Andrew’s
At St. Andrew’s, we believe that every member of our community is unique, cherished and valued. This belief sits at the heart of our school and shapes everything we do. Inspired by the letters of St Paul to the Corinthians and rooted in the Christian hope that every individual can flourish, we strive to ensure that all children grow in confidence, compassion and joy as they journey through their learning.
We recognise that each child arrives with their own experiences, strengths, needs and aspirations. As a school, we are committed to meeting every child exactly where they are—academically, socially, emotionally and spiritually. Through thoughtful support, personalised learning and high expectations, we aim to nurture each student so they can thrive in an ever-changing and challenging world.
St. Andrew’s is proud to be a school that serves its families and the wider community. We believe deeply in the power of strong relationships and the importance of working in partnership with parents, carers, churches and local organisations. Together, we create a warm and inclusive environment where children learn how to live well with others, embrace and celebrate their differences, and treat all people with dignity and respect.
Relationships, compassion and consistency form the foundation of our school culture. We understand that children learn best when they feel safe, valued and supported. Our staff are dedicated to creating classrooms and playgrounds where kindness is modelled, forgiveness is practised and every child is given the space and encouragement to grow.
Above all, our aim is for every child at St. Andrew’s to know that they are loved—by their school family, by their community and by God. Guided by our Christian faith, we help our pupils develop the skills, character and hope they need to flourish in learning and in life. We warmly invite you to discover more about our vibrant and nurturing school.

pageCache.text:
Deanery Schools Partnership
Deanery Schools Partnership
Moderation at St. Andrew's Barnsbury
St Andrew’s has the privilege of being part of the Islington Deanery network of schools. The strong bond between all eight schools ensures we are able to work together to develop best practice and drive both our own and the LDBS vision for all children to flourish.
This includes network meeting and events, curriculum development, professional development and joint moderation across deanery schools. We also run partnership events such as prayer days, collective worship, music, sporting and curriculum days.
Please see link below:
See link below for more information about the importance of small community church schools:
https://ldbs.co.uk/about-our-small-schools-3-5/
See link below for more information regarding the achievements of LDBS schools:
https://ldbs.co.uk/our-schools/
Located in a diverse and dynamic borough in North London, Islington Deanery Schools are a group of eight Primary schools who are working closely together to improve the lives of our community.
This forward thinking network of schools are joined together through work with The Diocese of London Board for Schools (LDBS) – a Christian organisation established in 1836 which supports over 160 Church of England schools in the Diocese of London.
The LDBS embraces the Church of England’s Vision for Education which which is deeply Christian with Jesus’ promise of ‘life in all its fullness’ at its heart.
